title: Create: Aeronautics
text: All Omnira crystal blocks, budding matrices, clusters at every growth stage and crystal building variants are weightless, including rough and excited spatial crystals. Every part of a crystal multiblock machine is also weightless, including the Large Alchemical Reaction Pool and Alchemical Catalysis Chamber. Simple Condensation Tables retain 0.5 mass, while Advanced Condensation Tables provide buoyancy.
Buoyancy of luminous materials follows their actual volume; slabs and stairs are not counted as full blocks. Weightlessness is not buoyancy: other materials, payload and propulsion still matter.
